title: <one line: what this release is>
what_changed: Concrete description of the change. Files, components, behavior.
why: The reason. The problem it solves or the improvement it makes. Evidence, not aspiration.

tests.test_output_ref: path to captured test output / proof note

reviewer.independent_reviewer: <who> (must be different from author for behavior changes)

release_notes: Human-readable summary of what shipped and the operator impact.
